description: This file defines the UnauthorizedException class within the OrangeHRM authentication module. It extends PHP's Exception class to include a Response object, allowing the exception to carry additional response data for HTTP handling.

classes.name: UnauthorizedException
classes.description: A custom exception class that extends PHP's Exception to include an HTTP Response object, used in the authentication process to handle unauthorized access scenarios.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a Response object, message, code, and optional previous Throwable.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the Response object associated with this exception.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets or updates the Response object associated with this exception.
